title: Facial Cue Training Lesson Schema
description: Schema for lessons in the facial cue training application

pages.definition: A highly nuanced form of sarcasm delivered with a neutral, serious, or impassive expression. Unlike overt sarcasm, which uses exaggerated pitch changes, deadpan relies entirely on the contradiction between the statement and the context.
visualCues: Neutral or completely relaxed facial muscles
A micro-expression of amusement (smirk) that appears only briefly
Stillness of the head (lack of nodding or shaking)
toneCues: Slightly faster tempo than usual speech
Lack of laughter or audible cues typically signaling a joke

scenario.context: Two senior engineers are looking at a server rack that has completely overheated and melted some wiring.
scenario.description: The situation is visibly catastrophic. The speakers share a bond of professional cynicism. The speaker is not attacking the listener, but commenting on the situation.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Flat, dry, devoid of emotion, slightly weary.

pages.transcript: Well, looking at this smoke, I'd say the cooling system is performing exactly as specified in the manual.

appropriateResponse.description: Match the dry wit. Do not panic or take the statement literally. Acknowledge the disaster through similar understatement.
keyElements: Agree with the absurdity of the statement
Do not offer a literal correction about the manual

scenario.context: A couple is hiking. They have been lost for two hours, and it has just started to hail.
scenario.description: Both partners are miserable, but they cope through shared humor. The speaker is trying to lighten the mood by framing the misery as a luxury experience.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Polite, conversational, as if reviewing a fine wine, despite the background noise of hail.

pages.transcript: You know, I really think the hail adds a textural element to the hike that mere rain just can't provide.

appropriateResponse.description: Lean into the bit. Treat the hail as a positive feature to build camaraderie in a bad situation.
keyElements: Validate the 'luxury' aspect of the complaint
Add another 'positive' feature of the miserable situation

scenario.context: Two friends are watching a movie that is critically acclaimed but incredibly boring and slow-paced.
scenario.description: They are sitting in silence until this comment breaks it. The sarcasm implies the movie is terrible without saying it directly.

audioSample.tonalPrompt: Whispered, serious, intellectual tone, feigning deep engagement.

pages.transcript: I'm on the edge of my seat. I think that character has blinked twice in the last forty-five minutes. Thrilling.

appropriateResponse.description: Acknowledge the boredom by validating the 'excitement' of the mundane action.
keyElements: Reciprocate the critique of the pacing
